title: 积木争霸0.12联机验收：最新功能通过，历史失败完整保留
current_user_scope: 500-unit lightweight gameplay; no additional seven-peer work or seven-peer15Hz release gate. Final normal-player release package checks remain separate.

release_relayfixed1.title: 0.12 最终发行前七人500单位公网复测：未通过
release_relayfixed1.scope: Native release template with diagnostic autoload PCK and seven actual headless Games; not editor runtime or an uninstrumented FPS acceptance run

outcome.notes: Each Game stopped its observation at first connection state interruption, then fixture barriers/reconnect/cleanup continued. Short per-owner observation windows differ and must not be compared as a complete 42-second sample.

clock_and_gap_limits: Client msec is process-relative and differs by launch order; first-disconnect ordering is corroborated by server UTC.
Snapshot max counts only successive received snapshots. Initial and terminal silence are missing; constant-count health rows establish lower bounds and prevent false pass.
Top-level max gap can keep changing during cleanup; use frozen stress_metrics.window_max_snapshot_gap_ms for observation.
No per-packet arrival history; no manufactured gap P95/P99.
12-32 second wall aggregate crosses disconnect/reconnect and cleanup, hence rejected as steady FPS evidence.
release_relayfixed1.cpu_scope: Full helper lifetime including startup/cleanup; not the exact 42-second battle window. Process CPU is summed across its threads, machine CPU across logical CPUs.

stress_metrics.scope: Seven headless Game processes share one CPU. Native ENet counters include transport traffic; not seven separate machines or FPS. Normal fog means every observer may see fewer than 500 units.

host_profile.scope: Diagnostic inclusive wall times, not process CPU; nested functions must not be summed. Windows contain the previous process-frame postlude; incomplete first/last windows possible. Performance values are cached previous-window maxima, not per-frame distributions.
host_profile.worker_scope: When present: worker fields collected only after native join by main thread; overlaps main work, never additive with main wall timers; encode includes graph release and queue is submit-to-worker-start wall.

release_ephemeral1.cpu_scope: Full helper lifetime including startup/cleanup; not the exact 42-second battle window. Process CPU is summed across its threads, machine CPU across logical CPUs.

watch_summary.cpu_scope: 60-second watch includes setup, match, cleanup and idle; not steady battle CPU utilization.

measurement_limits: Headless profiler loop Hz is not rendered FPS.
Different network phases and client/server changes, not isolated ABBA; do not claim sole cause for wall-time differences.
Per-step and per-frame nested inclusive wall metrics overlap; worker time is concurrent.
Snapshot gap only records consecutive arrivals; 1-second health rows give bounded terminal checks, not per-packet P95/P99.
Every observer uses normal fog and can receive fewer than500entities.
